name: Tiramisu Overnight Oats
description: Creamy chocolate-espresso overnight oats with a vanilla protein yoghurt topping. Make ahead and chill overnight. Ingredient weights are approximate metric conversions; nutrition figures are supplied estimates per serving and have not been recalculated.

ingredients.name: Raw cacao powder
ingredients.notes: Plus a little extra for dusting

steps.instruction: Combine 80 g rolled oats, 15 g cacao powder, 18 g chia seeds and a pinch of salt in a bowl.
Add 45 ml cooled espresso, 300 ml almond milk, 42 g honey and 5 ml vanilla extract. Stir thoroughly and transfer to two sealable jars or one large airtight container.
Whisk 360 g vanilla yoghurt, 10 g honey, 1 ml vanilla extract and 30 g vanilla protein powder until smooth.
Spread the yoghurt topping evenly over the oats and dust lightly with extra cacao powder.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 8 hours or overnight. Serve chilled, divided into two portions.
